decision: Approve reuse of the existing local and preview application connections from the signed-in Neon console for pinned direct checks, encrypted local storage and branch-only preview Secret binding.
rationale: Client twice failed manual setup and explicitly answered Approve existing app connections after automatic review rejected initial retrieval for insufficient authorization.
impact: Two existing restricted app credentials only; no password rotation, new privilege, production/recovery binding, public disclosure or metered dispatch. Plaintext values remain private in memory/child stdin; browser transfer files use RSA OAEP and persisted bindings use Windows CurrentUser DPAPI.
implementationStatus: Both direct app-role login/catalog checks pass. Distinct encrypted bindings saved; local profile stays off; Vercel preview Secret metadata confirms exact review branch. Browser profile acceptance remains open.
